Vet Tech Café is a podcast centered around Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Nurses.  We strive to discuss current issues faced by Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Nurses and give our colleagues a voice and a medium to enter into these discussions. We hope to be a resource for continued growth and education in our listeners.  With over 45 years of combined experience in the field and varied connections with other Technicians and Nurses, we will also bring to light other career paths that aren’t strictly working in the hospital setting.
